BC_description: In Commander v13.0.0, calling the 'parse()' method multiple times on a Command instance where 'storeOptionsAsProperties' is set to true will now throw an error. Previously, this may have been silently allowed or produced undefined behavior. The new behavior is: (a) If 'storeOptionsAsProperties' is true, a second and subsequent call to 'parse()' will throw an error. (b) If 'storeOptionsAsProperties' is false (the default), multiple calls to 'parse()' are supported. This affects the 'Command.parse' method only and does not apply to 'parseOptions()', which does not have this state tracking. This change prevents unintended side effects when properties are set directly on the Command instance due to 'storeOptionsAsProperties'.
